2026-10-07T13:48:29.2801804Z   92 | >>>     # revoked. So read the machine-readable status instead of the exit code.
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2802191Z   93 | >>>     #
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2802540Z   94 | >>>     # REVKEYSIG is never accepted. EXPKEYSIG is, and that is a bounded residual
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2802974Z   95 | >>>     # rather than a proof of anything: a signature's timestamp is chosen by
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2803413Z   96 | >>>     # whoever made it, so this does not establish that the signature predates the
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2803824Z   97 | >>>     # subkey's expiry. Refusing EXPKEYSIG is not available either — v2.7.4 is in
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2804136Z   98 | >>>     # the retained window and is signed by a now-expired subkey, and the EasyRSA
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2804473Z   99 | >>>     # block below has the same shape, its single signing subkey being expired too.
2026-10-07T13:48:29.2804737Z  100 | >>>     #

2026-10-07T13:48:29.2805844Z  104 | >>>     # as the residual it is, not covered by this check.
